notes: A family can now be published as the site's heading or body font, writing the typography tokens Etch documents and Automatic.css reads. Uploaded variable fonts get their axes, read from the file at upload. Library is now Font library and Upload fonts is now Font files, with files grouped by where they came from. Settings joined the save bar instead of committing on their own, the variable axes sit under the preview and actually move it, and deleting a font file now names the family it would leave empty.
